cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Build a Coalition
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to your side so your position appears broader and more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Sit with me for the allotment shed vote. It shouldn't look like just my project.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only support it if everyone gets a key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Shared keys. Agreed. Will you join me now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The new plot holders need to hear that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring them over. We can present it together as the shared-access proposal.

mechanism: A copies the wrong solidarity cue, then incorporates B correction into an invitation that broadens support for A position.
confusable: D52 wants a visible endorsement; D55 recruits a wider coalition, often through genuine concessions.
comparison: Shared allotment access versus joining different pottery classes.
seedUse: Preserve B conditions as real bargaining opportunities; no hostile obstacle required.
